info.title: Hyperplane.Server — Local Vector Decision Model HTTP Server Tool
info.description: Local HTTP server for Hyperplane vector decision models: the Decisions API (/api/alpha/decisions) plus Venn-compatible routes for outcome decisions, families, indexes, prepared questions, streaming index application and calibrations.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: hyperplane-server — local vector decision model server

commands.description: Download and verify the venn-1 head

options.description: Listen address (default 127.0.0.1)

options.description: Port (default 8000; 0 picks a free port)

options.description: Accept this Host header (repeatable; default loopback names)

options.description: Persist families and calibrations under <dir>/registry

options.description:
Load the venn-1 head from <dir> (default HYPERPLANE_HEAD_DIR,

options.name: --download-head
options.description: Download the venn-1 head to the cache before serving

options.name: --heuristic
options.description: Use the uncalibrated cosine head instead of venn-1

options.name: --reader
options.description:
none (vectors only, venn-1 profile) or deterministic
(hash vectors under an experimental profile, for demos)

options.name: --dimensions
options.description: Deterministic reader dimensions (default 64)
